I understand your request, but as a customer service assistant for Helix Bank, I do not have the ability to access specific account data, including transaction history. This information is only available through authenticated channels such as the mobile app or by contacting our secure phone line at 1-800-HELIX-CS.

If you need to verify the transactions for an internal audit, I would recommend reaching out to our secure phone line at 1-800-HELIX-CS so that a representative can assist you with accessing this information in a secure manner. They can guide you through the process and ensure that all procedures are followed correctly.<|im_end|>
